from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')

source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
                continue
            perimeter = {(y, x) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)
                         if y in (r0, r1) or x in (c0, c1)}
            if set(cells) == perimeter:
                for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                    for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                        out[y][x] = 7
    return out
'''

def frame_grid(h, w, bg, frames):
    g = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r0, c0, side, color in frames:
        for r in range(r0, r0 + side):
            for c in range(c0, c0 + side):
                if r in (r0, r0 + side - 1) or c in (c0, c0 + side - 1):
                    g[r][c] = color
    return g

def expected_grid(g, frames):
    o = [row[:] for row in g]
    for r0, c0, side, color in frames:
        fill = 7 if side % 2 else 2
        for r in range(r0 + 1, r0 + side - 1):
            for c in range(c0 + 1, c0 + side - 1):
                o[r][c] = fill
    return o
